title: Proofs of the Conjectures on $SOME(n)$ and $DSOME(n)$ Functions Related to Integer Partitions
summary: Andrews and Dastidar (2026) introduced $SOME(n)$ and $DSOME(n)$ functions related to partitions of a positive integer $n$, where $SOME(n)$ is the sum of all the odd parts in the partitions of $n$ minus the sum of all the even parts and $DSOME(n)$ is the sum of all the odd parts in the partitions of $n$ into distinct parts minusthe sum of all the even parts in the same partitions.
